notes:
This was a resume run. The paused run had already left a complete, passing atlas and tools workstream: schema with authoring rules for the other workstreams at the top of src/atlas/schema.ts, an import.meta.glob registry over src/atlas/entries/*.ts, every finding of the owned categories written, AtlasPage, FindingPage, ToolsPage with its 4 tabs, glossary and tests. I reviewed it against the task and the current contracts, kept it, and finished the remaining pieces:

1. Heart Lab link (merge decision). FindingPage now shows a side card 'Heart Lab: open in the Heart Lab' when labHref(id) is non-null. It is imported from '../lab/links' only: that file has type-only imports, so the lab engine is never loaded and the two engines never mix. tests/atlas/boundaries.test.ts enforces this. New i18n keys labTitle, labBody and labOpen are in zh/en/es.
2. Practice: the stub-era probe (practice as unknown) is replaced by a direct import of families() from src/practice, which is now really exported. It stays inside a try/catch.
3. Recording-chain exemplar fallback for technical findings. ExemplarSpec has a new optional fallback { scenario, recording, label }. It is used only while the synth catalogue has no scenario for the finding. It changes only the RecordingSpec (cable placement) on the 'normal' heart, which follows the one-source rule. The validator restricts it to technical findings, and the label is validated in all three languages. It is applied to LA/RA, LA/LL and RA/LL limb-cable reversals and to a V2/V3 swap (precordial misplacement). The engine already supports these placements. The page shows the label, e.g. 'Normal heart, LA and RA cables swapped', with a note that only the recording changed. EcgView overlays use only wave and interval truth, never finding labels, so the 'normal' truth does not mislead.
4. Glossary search now also matches the note text, as its doc comment already said.

No entry content was changed; the medical values were already checked against docs/curriculum/criteria.md with sources. No files outside the owned paths were edited. The temporary probe test and the scratch files I created were deleted.
